title_zh: 为中级写作密集课准备短篇摘录

scenario.label_zh: 为中级写作密集课准备短篇摘录
scenario.goal_zh: 核对课程强度和参加水平，并确认只需准备两页原创故事摘录

context_zh: 有一定写作经验的学员向课程协调员询问报名后的课前准备。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Gabriel
sentences.text: I've enrolled in the intensive writing course. Does intensive mean we'll write all day?

sentences.speaker: Suki
sentences.text: There are two workshops each morning and a short assignment for the afternoon. It's aimed at intermediate writers, not complete beginners.

sentences.speaker: Gabriel
sentences.text: I've taken a term of classes, but my manuscript is unfinished. Is that a problem?

sentences.speaker: Suki
sentences.text: No. We need two pages from an original story, not a complete book.

sentences.speaker: Gabriel
sentences.text: My opening includes a lengthy account of the village. Would a scene with two characters be more useful?

sentences.speaker: Suki
sentences.text: Yes, because the first workshop is about dialogue. Choose two pages where the characters want different things.

sentences.speaker: Gabriel
sentences.text: I'll bring the argument scene from my story, then. It's just under two pages.
